meta.question: Should an enterprise customer-support team introduce a generative AI assistant?

research_frame.question: Should an enterprise customer-support team introduce a generative AI assistant?
research_frame.comparison: Existing support workflow without generative AI suggestions.
research_frame.success_condition: Improve verified resolutions per paid staff hour while preserving service quality, privacy and staff autonomy.

extensions.note: Purposive evidence selection, not a systematic review or model execution benchmark.

decision.decision_question: Should an enterprise customer-support team introduce a generative AI assistant?
decision.target_population: Enterprise customer-support staff, stratified by tenure and baseline skill.
decision.target_context: Human-supervised support using an approved knowledge base.
supported_claims: AI assistance can shorten customer chat handling in a bounded support setting; throughput is a separate outcome.
ChatGPT reduced time on short professional writing tasks; this is indirect evidence for customer support.
AI can reduce correctness on tasks outside its capability frontier; consulting evidence is indirect for support.
Experienced, high-skill support staff need separate quality monitoring rather than assumed uniform benefits.
uncertain_claims: Local net cost, privacy incident rates, subgroup service quality and sustained performance are not established by this selected evidence set.
decision.decision_rationale: A supervised pilot is warranted because one direct field study supports efficiency gains but also reveals heterogeneous quality effects. Indirect experiments identify task boundaries, while local safety and net value remain unknown.
decision.methodology_summary: One staggered-rollout quasi-experiment and two randomized experiments. Only the support study is direct; no pooled standardized effect or model benchmark was computed.
what_cannot_be_claimed: Universal gains, autonomous deployment safety, privacy protection, reduced staffing requirements or educational learning gains.
missing_evidence: Local net cost, privacy incident rates, subgroup service quality and sustained performance are not established by this selected evidence set.

required_conditions: Start with low-risk, knowledge-base-covered queues; agents inspect and edit every proposed reply.
Stratify by tenure and baseline skill; retain expert discretion and measure review workload.
Minimize and redact customer data, restrict access and retention, and review supplier data-use terms before a pilot.
Escalate unfamiliar, ambiguous, sensitive or high-stakes requests to qualified humans; no autonomous commitments.

extensions.note: Conservative manual judgment about broad deployment; not a deterministic confidence-policy run or a probability.

knowledge_gaps.summary: Local net cost, privacy incident rates, subgroup service quality and sustained performance are not established by this selected evidence set.

decision.strongest_support: Supervised AI assistance improves handling speed and answer consistency in customer-support work, with quality maintained.
decision.key_uncertainty: Evidence comes from adjacent writing and advisory settings rather than the support floor, so transfer to live customer conversations is unproven.
decision.main_risk: Unsupervised or knowledge-base-free use can produce confident wrong answers to customers, and over-reliance erodes agent skill over time.
decision.next_action: Run a supervised pilot on approved knowledge bases with human review on every reply, and track escalation and correction rates.

evaluation.research_question: Should an enterprise customer-support team introduce a generative AI assistant?

groups.treatment: Eligible teams randomly assigned to supervised assistant access, stratified by tenure and baseline performance.
groups.comparison: Concurrent teams retaining the existing workflow; document contamination.

evaluation.baseline: Record resolution rate, paid hours, repeat contacts, blinded quality and review costs before allocation.
evaluation.post_test: Assess the same outcomes at pilot end; separately audit privacy and unsafe commitments.
evaluation.analysis_plan: Preregister an intention-to-treat comparison with team-clustered uncertainty and subgroup estimates. Set sample size and noninferiority margins from local baseline variance and operational priorities before enrollment.
evaluation.success_threshold: Expand only if quality is noninferior, verified resolutions per paid hour improve, net cost is acceptable and no serious unresolved safety incident remains; thresholds require local agreement.
stop_conditions: Pause immediately after a verified privacy leak or a serious unsafe or unauthorized customer commitment; investigate before resuming.
Pause expansion if blinded quality review crosses a pre-agreed noninferiority margin, including within experience strata.
